description: Lt. Governor Leslie Rutledge today announced a strong wave of endorsements in her re-election campaign, including support from Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders, U.S. Senators John Boozman and Tom Cotton, U.S. Representatives French Hill, Steve Womack, Bruce Westerman, and Rick Crawford, as well as state legislative leaders Senate President Pro Tempore Bart Hester and House Speaker Brian Evans.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY LESLIE RUTLEDGE FOR LT
title: LT. GOVERNOR LESLIE RUTLEDGE ANNOUNCES MAJOR ENDORSEMENTS IN RE-ELECTION CAMPAIGN
